purpose: Repaint HL2 clothing surfaces while preserving original UV island layout.

images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Half-Life 2 clothing UV texture atlas into a finished gang clothing diffuse texture. This is a PRODUCTION UV ATLAS, never a character illustration. CRITICAL: preserve EXACT square canvas, every UV island silhouette, location, scale, rotation, every seam, cuff, collar, button line, pocket, strap, buckle, boot sole and all skin/hand areas. Do not move, enlarge, repack or invent islands. Keep all black/grey unused space exactly in place. Keep skin unchanged. Repaint surface materials with hand-crafted realistic worn cloth/leather detail, repaired stitching, abrasion and subtle dirt in the grounded gritty HL2 aesthetic. Preserve readable midtones, no uniformly black crushed shadows. Pants dark neutral denim, boots worn black/brown leather, straps dark webbing and buckles steel, never tint the entire sheet one color. Replace resistance lambda and medical crosses where present with small faction motifs. NO text, watermark, border, lighting setup, extra objects. Output only the complete edited square UV atlas at the reference resolution. BLACK RAVEN: weathered charcoal leather jacket, graphite cloth, grey stitching, ivory raven patches. Light civilian male outfit.
